items.title: Pseudo-coherence is preserved by derived base change
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that pseudo-coherence at a degree survives the derived base change, and the proof is a 31-line argument that transports the witnessing map through the tensor product. It first notes that the derived tensor product is defined because the complex is bounded above, then chooses the bounded complex of finite free modules witnessing the pseudo-coherence, forms its cone and observes that the cone is acyclic above the given degree; exactness of the derived tensor product turns this into a distinguished triangle over the new ring, the vanishing statement for cones keeps the acyclicity, and since a bounded complex of free modules computes its own derived tensor product, the base changed map is the required witness. The two vanishings and the identification of the base changed free complex are the substance.
